description: Performance. Style. Fun. The Hyper Spy 20" BMX delivers it all. Take your riding to the next level with the Hyper Spy 20" BMX Bike, built for riders who want to learn tricks, cruise the neighborhood, and have fun on two wheels. Its durable steel BMX frame and BMX design provide a solid foundation for everything from everyday rides to freestyle riding. The Hyper Spy features a 360 degree rotating handlebar, plus front and rear pegs for practicing and mastering a variety of BMX tricks. Front caliper and rear linear pull brakes provide dependable stopping power, while the 68 spoke steel rims, chrome accents, and sleek black finish give this bike an eye catching BMX look. A padded seat and comfortable, gripped handlebars make it easy to keep riding, whether you're hitting the streets, practicing tricks, or cruising with friends. With a single speed micro drive and low maintenance BMX design, the Hyper Spy keeps things simple so riders can focus on having fun. Built to ride. Designed to perform. Made to stand out.
